title: asperula nitida subsp. hirtella
intro: Asperula nitida subsp. hirtella, commonly known as Wood Sorrel, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Wood Sorrel include its ability to act as a diuretic, astringent, and expectorant, making it useful for treating conditions such as urinary tract infections and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Wood Sorrel include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
